newsitem.title: USA: LG&E assumes wind power project operation.
newsitem.headline: LG&E assumes wind power project operation.

text.p: LG&E Power Operating Services said Thursday it assumed operating and maintenance responsibilities for three wind-power projects last Friday formerly operated by Kenetech Windpower Inc.

Other LG&E Energy Corp subsidiaries are part owners of the projects, which are located in Tyler, Minn.; Palm Springs, Calif.; and Culberson County, Texas. The projects have a combined capacity of about 120 megawatts generated by nearly 300 wind turbines.
On May 29, Kenetech Windpower filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code and continued to operate these projects on an interim basis.

LG&E Power Operating Services said it has agreed with the projects' owners to assume operation and maintenance of the facilities and will employ about 21 former Kenetech Windpower employees in connection with that effort. Kenetech Windpower continues to hold its partnership interests in the projects.
